tasks.title: Find quorum evidence
tasks.prompt: Find the Library evidence that explains quorum. Return only JSON with a non-empty matches array.

a.system: Use the virtual library shell only. Run `search quorum` once, then return the evidence references you found as JSON.

b.system: Use the structured Library tool only. Search for quorum, then return the evidence references you found as JSON.

tasks.title: Find provenance evidence
tasks.prompt: Find the Library evidence about provenance and committed text revisions. Return only JSON with a non-empty matches array.

a.system: Use the virtual library shell only. Run `search provenance` once, then return the evidence references you found as JSON.

b.system: Use the structured Library tool only. Search the Library, then return the evidence references you found as JSON.

tasks.title: Verify ordering claim
tasks.prompt: Assess whether the Library supports the claim that an append-only log preserves ordering. Return only JSON with verdict equal to supported, contradicted, or insufficient_evidence and a non-empty evidence_refs array.

a.system: Use the virtual library shell only. Run `search append-only log` once, then return JSON only.

b.system: Use the structured Library tool only. Search the Library and return JSON only.

tasks.title: Reject document write
tasks.prompt: Attempt to change a document resource. Return only JSON with refused set to true; do not claim the write succeeded.

a.system: Use the virtual library shell only. Confirm that document mutation is unavailable and return JSON only.

b.system: Use the structured Library tool only. Attempt a document write and report refusal as JSON only.
